svg.title: Encrypted DNS and DNSSEC protect different parts of a lookup
svg.desc: Transport encryption protects a configured client-to-resolver hop. A resolver doing DNSSEC validation checks signed records along a chain of trust separately.

g.text: Encrypted DNS and DNSSEC protect different parts of a lookup
DoH or DoT protects query content on this hop.
The selected resolver can read the query.
Check signed data against the chain of trust.
Unsigned data has no DNSSEC authentication.
A deployment can use both. Check transport and DNSSEC validation independently.
